! Baseline comparison input: original empirical CNCS12 resolution.

&basic
ntypes = 2
natoms = 12
nsize = 2 2 2
/

&inputsqe
elements = "Pd"  "Se"
nat = 4 8
temp = 300.d0
lneutron = .TRUE.
lxray = .FALSE.
qmesh = 20 20 20
read_rmsd = .TRUE.
espresso = .FALSE.
! Sample orientation vectors in reciprocal-lattice units.
! These play the same role as u/v in the two local PSF examples.
! u = [1, 0, 0]
! v = [0, 1, 0]
path(:,1) = 1.d0   0.d0   0.d0
ne = 320
deltaE = 0.05
nqh = 100
nqk = 5
nql = 5
deltaH = 0.005
deltaK = 0.001
deltaL = 0.001
q0 = 2.d0 0.d0 0.d0
nonanalytic = .FALSE.
lresfunc = .TRUE.
functype = "CNCS12"
xm = 1

! TAS switches are explicitly disabled here.
! tas_mode='none' keeps the legacy empirical CNCS12 resolution path.
! tas_use_cn=.FALSE. prevents the Cooper-Nathans TAS branch from activating.
tas_mode = 'none'
tas_use_cn = .FALSE.
/
